title: Clinical AI Diagnostics & Digital Healthcare Innovation
grammar: Concession and Necessity in Medical Decisions
goal: I can describe how AI is used in medical imaging and diagnosis (*képalkotás, radiológiai diagnosztika, klinikai döntéstámogatás*).

I can discuss patient safety and the doctor's responsibility in formal Hungarian.
